body:
## Summary
- extract Android clipboard confirmation preview formatting into ClipboardPreviewPolicy
- add JVM coverage for per-line wrapping, exact 280-character non-truncation, 281-character truncation-before-wrapping, and empty preview behavior
- add focused clipboard evidence noting this remains local Android/JVM coverage and does not prove Android ClipboardManager <-> macOS NSPasteboard product E2E

## Verification
- cd baseline/AndroidClient && ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ClipboardPreviewPolicyTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.MainActivityClipboardSystemBoundaryContractTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ClientExperienceTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.ClipboardApprovalStateTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.protocol.ProtocolV1ClipboardTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.protocol.ProtocolV1ClipboardFailClosedTest --tests dev.telemachus.display.internet.InternetClipboardTest
- adb -s <redacted-adb-serial> get-state / getprop identity checks observed nubia P0110 / pacific / Android 16 / API 36; adb reverse --list printed no tcp:54321 mapping

## Boundaries
- did not start Vibe Screen/MacHost/Telemachus GUI
- did not run swift run
- did not request or modify Screen Recording, Accessibility, Microphone, Keychain, TCC, or System Settings
- did not create adb reverse tcp:54321 tcp:54321
- did not access macOS NSPasteboard and does not claim product clipboard E2E
title: test(android): cover clipboard preview policy
